List the tests a change can break — by rule and region where the project declares them.

```text
Lists the tests to run for what changed: the given files, or, with none, every file that
differs from the last commit.

  a spec's rule, or a code region '#region [CODE]', changed  → the tests whose title carries CODE
  a file changed outside its regions                          → every test whose evidence closure holds it
  a test file changed                                         → all of its tests

The formats:
  lines   one test title per line (default)
  regex   one anchored alternation of the titles: go test -run "$(anchors affected-tests --format regex)"
  files   the test files, one per line
  json    the tests with file, line and title

With no 'dialect.tests' declared the titles cannot be read, and the test files are printed.
The gate run stays whole for the CI; this serves the short cycle of whoever is working.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors affected-tests [file...] [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `lines` | lines \| regex \| files \| json |
| `--map` |  | path to the map |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

| [`anchors stale`](/docs/cli/commands/stale/) | List stale edges — what changed and has not been reconfronted |
| **`anchors affected-tests`** | List the tests a change can break — by rule and region where the project declares them |
| [`anchors impact`](/docs/cli/commands/impact/) | Impact analysis: what a change to this file reaches |
| [`anchors failures`](/docs/cli/commands/failures/) | The observed failures that the spec has not yet explained |
